title: ShieldCare Fee Schedule: Grace, Late Fee, Free Look, Refund Basis and Transfer
content:
## Fees and windows recorded against each plan

| Plan | Days an unpaid instalment may run before the plan is ended | Late fee of the plan, USD | Free look from activation, days | How premium is refunded after the free look | Administration fee kept, USD | Plan may move with the item | Fee to transfer, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ShieldCare Essential Parts and Labour | 0 | 0.00 | 30 | no refund after the free look | 0.00 | no | 0.00 |
| ShieldCare Accidental Damage Plus | 21 | 9.00 | 30 | pro rata by whole unused months, claims paid deducted | 25.00 | yes | 25.00 |
| ShieldCare Total Device Protection | 30 | 9.00 | 45 | pro rata by whole unused months, claims paid deducted | 25.00 | yes | 25.00 |
| ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium | 30 | 15.00 | 45 | pro rata by whole unused months, claims paid deducted | 35.00 | yes | 40.00 |
| ShieldCare Major Appliance Extended Service | 30 | 12.00 | 30 | pro rata by whole unused months, claims paid deducted | 25.00 | yes | 30.00 |
| ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection | 45 | 25.00 | 60 | pro rata by whole unused months, claims paid deducted | 50.00 | no | 0.00 |

### Notes to the schedule

1. Grace days and the late fee belong together: the grace days are the days an unpaid
   instalment may run before the plan is terminated for non-payment, and the late fee of the
   plan is the fee entered beside them. ShieldCare Essential Parts and Labour is sold for a
   single payment only and carries 0 grace days and a late fee of 0.00.
2. The free look is counted from the day the plan was activated and runs from 30 days on
   ShieldCare Essential Parts and Labour, ShieldCare Accidental Damage Plus and ShieldCare
   Major Appliance Extended Service to 60 days on ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection.
3. Of the six Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plans, only ShieldCare Essential Parts and
   Labour gives no refund at all after the free look. The other five refund pro rata by whole
   unused months with claims already paid deducted, and each keeps the administration fee
   entered above.
4. Transfer is allowed on four plans. Where it is not allowed — ShieldCare Essential Parts and
   Labour and ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection — the transfer fee is entered as 0.00
   because no transfer is priced. The highest transfer fee in the schedule is the 40.00 on
   ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium.
